# Morgan Thermal Ceramics

> Morgan Thermal Ceramics is a global leader in thermal management, insulation, and fire protection solutions for industrial, transportation, aerospace, and energy applications.

The company provides a comprehensive portfolio of thermal ceramic products including Superwool, FireMaster, Min-K Microporous, and Vacupor technologies. With manufacturing facilities and offices worldwide, Morgan Thermal Ceramics serves diverse industries from automotive and aerospace to power generation and metals processing.

## Key Topics

- Thermal Management
- Thermal Insulation
- Fire Protection
- Battery Safety
- Superwool
- FireMaster
- Min-K Microporous
- Heat Shields
- Furnace Linings
- Electric Vehicles
- Fuel Cells
- HRSG Boilers
- Thermal Runaway Protection
- Energy Efficiency
- Sustainability

## Industry Solutions

- [Industries Overview](https://www.morganthermalceramics.com/en-gb/industries): Overview of thermal management solutions across industries including HRSG and fuel cells
- [Transportation Thermal & Safety Solutions](https://www.morganthermalceramics.com/en-gb/industries/transportation): Transportation thermal solutions including battery safety and heat shields for vehicles
- [Aerospace & Aeronautical Insulation](https://www.morganthermalceramics.com/en-gb/industries/aerospace): Aerospace thermal insulation using Min-K Microporous and Superwool materials
- [Automotive Heat Shield & Thermal Solutions](https://www.morganthermalceramics.com/en-gb/industries/automotive): Automotive heat shields and thermal solutions for electric vehicles and emissions control
- [Battery Safety & Thermal Runaway Protection](https://www.morganthermalceramics.com/en-gb/industries/battery-safety): EST Papers for lithium-ion battery thermal runaway protection in vehicles
- [Marine Insulation & Fire Protection](https://www.morganthermalceramics.com/en-gb/industries/marine): Marine fire protection and thermal insulation using FireMaster certified systems
- [Railway Thermal & Safety Solutions](https://www.morganthermalceramics.com/en-gb/industries/rail): Railway thermal management and fire protection for trains and tank cars

## Energy & Manufacturing

- [Energy Thermal Ceramic Solutions](https://www.morganthermalceramics.com/en-gb/industries/energy): Thermal ceramics for petrochemical, renewable energy and fuel cell applications
- [Power Generation Products & Applications](https://www.morganthermalceramics.com/en-gb/industries/power-generation): Thermal insulation for power generation HRSG boilers and renewable energy
- [Fuel Cells Thermal Management](https://www.morganthermalceramics.com/en-gb/industries/fuel-cells): Thermal ceramics for SOFC and MCFC fuel cell thermal management applications
- [Petrochemical & Refinery Solutions](https://www.morganthermalceramics.com/en-gb/industries/petrochemical-refinery): Refractory insulation for petrochemical refineries and energy efficiency
- [Metals Furnace Linings & Consumables](https://www.morganthermalceramics.com/en-gb/industries/metals): Furnace linings and refractory solutions for iron, steel and metal manufacturing
- [Iron & Steel Thermal Refractory Solutions](https://www.morganthermalceramics.com/en-gb/industries/iron-steel): Superwool XTRA and refractory solutions for iron and steel furnace applications
- [Aluminium Furnace Linings & Casting](https://www.morganthermalceramics.com/en-gb/industries/aluminium): Superwool thermal insulation for aluminium furnace linings and casting processes

## Construction & Safety

- [Building and Construction Passive Fire Protection](https://www.morganthermalceramics.com/en-gb/industries/building-construction): FireMaster passive fire protection for building construction and structural steel
